title: Avro Lancaster W4938
memorial_details: Plain, rectangular, brass plaque with black, captal lettering.
inscription: IN LOVING MEMORY OF MY HUSBAND/ 1331635 SGT. THOMAS HENRY SKELTON,/ AGED 19 YEARS, WHO FLEW FROM LANGAR/ AIRFIELD ON THE NIGHT OF MAY 13TH 1943/ TO GERMANY AND NEVER RETURNED./ ALSO TO ALL MEMBERS OF HIS CREW/ ALWAYS REMEMBERED.
narrative: On the night of 13 May 1943, Lancaster W4938 took off from Langar Airfield in Nottinghamshire on a mission to Germany and did not return. Sergeant Thomas Henry Skelton (service number 1331635), aged 19, was among the crew lost. A brass plaque erected by his wife at the former airfield — now Langar Skydiving Club — records his loss and commemorates all members of his crew.
